rows.my_view: Meaningfully undervalued with a $13 base against $8.45.
rows.committee: Price sits near the $7 bear with real asymmetry, but the $13 base is live only if the mix shift proves real on Nov 11.

rows.my_view: Total revenue can fall while intrinsic earnings power rises as low-margin procurement rolls off.
rows.committee: The mechanism is legitimate, but a 20% revenue drop may be demand decay rather than deliberate mix shift until segment dollars confirm it.

rows.my_view: Mix shift lifts margins and operating leverage lets cash flow grow faster than revenue.
rows.committee: Gross margin fell 29%→13% every year as revenue grew and capex scaled faster than sales, so operating leverage has zero historical support.

rows.my_view: An entrenched, deep integration layer built on the Dell relationship.
rows.committee: The switching-cost story is entirely unverified and scale has worked against margins, so this is a plausible position, not a proven moat.

rows.my_view: Capex is capacity investment that will pay off as AI-rack demand arrives.
rows.committee: Capex compounded to $32.7M while even peak-year FY2025 threw off just 0.9% FCF margin, and ~50% share dilution in four years quietly eroded the cheap multiple.

rows.my_view: Dell dependence — whether this is a durable business or just outsourced Dell labor.
rows.committee: Same read: Dell concentration is the thesis-killer, and the owner front-ran the entire skeptic critique in one sentence.

rows.my_view: Cited his own ~46%/~84% segment percentages as confirmed proof of the mix shift.
rows.committee: Those are percentages on an undisclosed base, not dollar growth — the thesis rests on gross-profit dollars nobody has yet seen, alongside silent dilution and a 0.9% peak FCF margin.
Total gross-profit dollars YoY on the Nov 11 print: up while revenue falls confirms the mix shift; down alongside revenue confirms demand decay.

confidence.label: Moderate
confidence.why: The setup is unusually monitorable and resolves on one date and one disclosure, but the single most decision-relevant fact — Dell concentration and segment dollars — is absent from every source.

final_verdict: A legitimate coin-flip-sized open on genuine asymmetry, but the operating-leverage and moat claims fail the evidence, so conviction waits on the Nov 11 print.
